title: San Diego Trivia Night

questions.q: The San Diego Zoo sits inside which large park, home to the 1915 Panama-California Exposition?
Which explorer sailed into San Diego Bay in 1542 and is honored by a national monument on Point Loma?
Which Franciscan friar founded Mission San Diego de Alcalá in 1769, the first of the California missions?
Which aircraft carrier, retired in 1992, is now a museum on the downtown waterfront?
What is the name of San Diego's Major League Baseball team?
Which fan convention, first held in 1970, fills the San Diego Convention Center each summer?
A long, curving blue bridge across San Diego Bay, opened in 1969, links the city to which neighboring city?
The Hotel del Coronado stood in for a Florida resort in which 1959 Billy Wilder comedy starring Marilyn Monroe?
The 1986 film Top Gun is set at the Navy's fighter weapons school, then based at which San Diego naval air station?
Which 2004 Will Ferrell comedy follows a 1970s news anchor who signs off with "Stay classy, San Diego"?

notes: San Diego Zoo is in Balboa Park, site of the 1915-16 Panama-California Exposition; see Balboa Park (Wikipedia) or balboapark.org.
Cabrillo entered San Diego Bay on 28 September 1542; Cabrillo National Monument is on Point Loma; see Cabrillo National Monument (NPS, nps.gov/cabr).
Founded 16 July 1769 by Junípero Serra, first of the 21 Alta California missions; see Mission San Diego de Alcalá (Wikipedia).
USS Midway decommissioned 1992, opened as a museum in 2004 at Navy Pier; see USS Midway Museum (Wikipedia) or midway.org.
San Diego Padres, MLB since 1969; see San Diego Padres (Wikipedia) or MLB.com.
First San Diego comic convention held in 1970; now held each July at the San Diego Convention Center; see San Diego Comic-Con (Wikipedia).
San Diego-Coronado Bridge opened August 1969, painted blue; see San Diego-Coronado Bridge (Wikipedia) or Caltrans.
Some Like It Hot (1959) used the Hotel del Coronado as the Florida 'Seminole Ritz'; see Some Like It Hot or Hotel del Coronado (Wikipedia).
Top Gun (1986) set at the Navy Fighter Weapons School, then at NAS Miramar (moved to Fallon, Nevada, in 1996); see Top Gun (Wikipedia) or United States Navy Strike Fighter Tactics Instructor program.
Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004), set at a San Diego TV station, catchphrase 'Stay classy, San Diego'; see Anchorman (Wikipedia).
